_comment: Jobs the release gate's local copy of CI (pr-release-gate, ci_mirror.py) may skip in this repository. Every entry needs a reason, and a skipped job is a counted gap, never a pass. scripts/ci/__tests__/nexus-receipt-workflow.test.mjs fails if the nexus-release-receipt.yml or nexus-sandbox-proof.yml entry is widened beyond its one job.

exempt.reason: Writes the nexus/release-receipt status and a PR comment on GitHub, using the CODEX_AUTH_JSON secret held on the nexus-release-receipt environment and the Actions run link. A developer machine has neither and must not write that status, so this job cannot run locally. Its decision logic is still checked locally: the verdict-tests job of the same workflow stays in the local copy, and scripts/ci/__tests__/nexus-receipt-workflow.test.mjs checks the wiring between the two jobs.

Runs the Codex sandbox on a Linux GitHub runner: it needs bubblewrap, Linux user namespaces, /proc and passwordless sudo for the AppArmor user-namespace setting, none of which a macOS developer machine has, and macOS results would prove nothing about the runner because the macOS sandbox exposes different paths. The pure verdict and probe logic still runs locally: scripts/ci/nexus-receipt/sandbox.test.mjs is in the verdict-tests job and in scripts/ci/mjs-test-manifest.txt, and scripts/ci/__tests__/nexus-receipt-workflow.test.mjs checks the shape of this workflow.
